mods.description: KOZMOS Toolmarks: badges on tool rows. Each finished call gets a family-colored glyph and its duration at the row's end, Bash calls their exit status, failed calls a red mark, and a folded group its total time and failures. /toolmarks toggles them.

mods.name: verdict
mods.description: KOZMOS Verdict: test, build and lint results above the prompt. Spots the test runners, type checkers, linters and builds Claude runs (vitest, jest, pytest, go test, cargo, dotnet, mocha, bun, tsc, eslint, npm run build, maven, gradle…), parses pass/fail/skip and error counts, and shows chips like '…

mods.name: vitals
mods.description: KOZMOS Vitals: a btop-style machine monitor sidebar. CPU with a braille history graph, RAM bar and history, disk use, NVIDIA GPU load, memory and temperature, process count, and the Claude side: session time, tool calls, running agents. Samples every 2 s only while open. /vitals toggles it.

mods.name: warden
mods.description: KOZMOS Warden: a guard for destructive shell commands. Before Claude or a subagent runs rm -rf on a broad path, git push --force, reset --hard, clean -fd, DROP TABLE, mkfs, format, curl | sh and their kin, warden asks you (Allow once / Deny) and refuses when no one can answer. A band flashes for 8…

mods.name: warpdrive
mods.description: KOZMOS Warpdrive: a starfield at warp above the prompt. Stars stream out of the center at the speed of Claude's live output token rate: a slow drift while it thinks, hyperspace streaks while it writes. When a turn ends, a jump flash and a line like '⇢ arrived · 42s · 18.4k tok'. /warpdrive toggles…

mods.name: painel
mods.description: Painel lateral no estilo do OpenCode: o que o Claude está fazendo, o pensamento ao vivo, os próximos passos, os arquivos editados (+/−) e o contexto.

mods.name: cc-mod-park
mods.description: /park a session you will come back to; a new session in the same folder offers it back with one click.

mods.name: cc-askpass
mods.description: Lets Claude run commands that ask for a password (sudo, ssh, git): a pane inside Claude Code asks you, and the password never reaches the model

mods.name: dispatch-board
mods.description: 多個 Claude Code session 分工時的派工看板：讀你寫的 mission 檔，顯示誰完成、誰在跑、誰在等你，狀態轉換時跳 toast

mods.name: dispatch-relay
mods.description: dispatch-board 的搭檔：worker session 把回報寫進結果檔後以一行結束，由 mod 在 turn 結束時把新增內容與最終回覆轉送給指揮站；背景工作進行中的回覆暫存、延後併送（mission 檔寫了 station 才啟用；需 Claude Code ≥ 2.1.296）

mods.name: handoff-runner
mods.description: bg session 在 worktree 做完的分支，由你在面板按一顆按鈕快轉進 main：交接單只帶參數，步驟由 mod 推導，執行前檢查、執行後驗證

mods.name: working-memory
mods.description: 把 context window 畫成一顆腦：工具呼叫點亮對應腦區，用量越滿越擁擠，compact 時睡眠整理

mods.name: georgian-bridge
mods.description: Translates the Georgian in each prompt to English before Claude reads it, without echoing the translation

mods.name: grammar-fix
mods.description: Fixes the grammar and spelling of each English prompt before Claude reads it, and shows what changed

mods.name: podium
mods.description: Hand work to any agent CLI on your machine and see and control it from one pane.

mods.name: nanoflow
mods.description: nanoflow by nanosite.ai: your dev workflow, live. Worktrees on their own ports, tickets, PRs/CI, checks and Playwright as a dashboard pane, a progress status line and toasts, plus dev skills.

mods.name: qa-guide
mods.description: Shows Claude's questions in a side pane with context, option details, an AI explanation and answer history; also explains questions Claude asks in plain text.

mods.name: workflow-watch
mods.description: Live view of a running Workflow: each stage as it starts and finishes, with what it is doing right now, in a pane, a band above the prompt and the status line.

mods.name: pixel-buddy-sam
mods.description: 像素剩余额度、七种状态地点与浅深主题动画，配合主会话优先、后台等待、真实压缩与实际阈值读数

mods.name: pixelband
mods.description: Animated pixel art above your Claude Code prompt that reacts while Claude works: seven scenes, or your own image or GIF. Zero tokens.

mods.name: jev-blindspot-band
mods.description: A one-glance summary of jev-blindspot in the band above the prompt: the blind spot count, the deeper question, and the top findings for the prompt you just sent.

mods.name: open-todos
mods.description: Side pane listing unfinished and in-progress todos from all Claude Code sessions, grouped by project

mods.name: token-usage
mods.description: 5h / 7d usage, token totals and cost pills above the prompt

mods.name: flow-scenes
mods.description: Ambient scenes above the prompt that move with your agent's work: a fire, bubbles, surf, ski, rockets, a hot-air balloon and more, by day or night. /flow to control it.

mods.name: redact
mods.description: Masks credential-shaped strings in a Read tool result before the model reads it.

mods.name: handoff-compact
mods.description: Replaces Claude Code's compaction with a structured handoff: a fork of the session writes it from the prompt cache, and the conversation continues from exactly that handoff.

mods.name: agents-view
mods.description: A pane listing this session's subagents (Agent tool and workflow agents) with their status; select one to see its prompt, text, tool calls and results.

mods.name: file-view
mods.description: Click a file path under a Read, Edit or Write row to show that file's contents in a pane beside the transcript.

mods.name: pr-view
mods.description: A pane listing the project root repository's open pull requests with titles; click one to open it in the browser.

mods.name: agentpane
mods.description: A side pane for Claude Code that lists the subagents a session runs, what each is doing and what it costs in tokens, with each one's conversation a click away.

mods.name: statuspane
mods.description: A floating status card above the Claude Code prompt — model, effort, context, 5h/week limits, cost, directory and branch, GitHub CI and deploys — with clickable settings and a progress-row API any script or mod can feed.

mods.name: awsh
mods.description: awsh for Claude Code: an `aw` subagent type whose model steps are answered by a session on the local awsh harness daemon, so any harness and any backend the daemon can drive runs as a native Claude Code subagent, streamed live. Also carries the Aither World skills, the `aither` output style, MCP se…

mods.name: awcompact
mods.description: Compacts a long tool result through the AitherOS decision door before the model reads it: per LINE SHAPE, learned from outcomes, never dropping a traceback or a summary line.

mods.name: jev-pilot
mods.description: TypeSafe's Jev decides how Claude Code works on each prompt: the main conversation's reasoning effort (low to xhigh, raised to max mid-turn when tool calls keep failing), each subagent's model, whether to split the work across subagents, and the one skill the prompt needs. Brings in custom OpenRout…

mods.name: simple-english
mods.description: Apply technical and house-style writing rules to writes, edits, git commit messages, and replies. Needs Claude Code 2.1.296 or later.

mods.name: action-pin
mods.description: After an edit that adds a GitHub Actions step pinned to a tag or a branch, names the commit SHA to write instead, from the GitHub API.

mods.name: ask-autopick
mods.description: Picks the recommended option of a question that waited unanswered for a set time, so a session you left does not stop. Off until you turn it on.

mods.name: bash-diet
mods.description: Shrinks each Bash result before the model reads it: per-command filters for git, test runners, linters, package managers, containers and file tools, the full output kept in a file.

mods.name: bg-tasks
mods.description: Shows the background shell tasks of the session on the status line or in the shared sidebar, with the oldest one's age, and stops one from the /bg-tasks pane.

mods.name: bughunt
mods.description: Runs proof-driven bug hunt rounds with /bughunt: each round proves one bug with a failing command the mod runs itself, fixes it, and proves the fix, and the loop stops on a blocked or unverified round. /bughunt collab runs a read-only scanner, planner and critic in sequence.

mods.name: cache-warm
mods.description: Keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm for a window you set, or with no end in every session under always, with one cache-shared fork per idle stretch and one keep-warm message after a resume, arms a window for you after a paid cold write, and shows the cache state, the cold price and this session's co…

mods.name: commit-cadence
mods.description: Names the uncommitted files to you at the end of each turn, and tells the model at the next prompt to commit each finished piece as it lands.

mods.name: config-parse
mods.description: Parses each JSON, YAML, TOML or .env file an Edit or Write touches, notes a parse error at once instead of at the next build, and says so again when a later edit fixes it.

mods.name: context-restore
mods.description: Hands a skill or command call the current text of its file when the file changed on disk after the session loaded it, and hands the model a rules file or the global CLAUDE.md that changed on disk.

mods.name: contract-watch
mods.description: After the model changes a function signature with Edit, adds the callers ripwire finds to the Edit's result, so the model fixes them before the build does.

mods.name: council
mods.description: Asks a council of models about a hard problem, when the model calls its tool or you run /council <question>: Claude models, and Gemini models when gemini-core has a key, answer in parallel, and the model of the session writes one verdict from their answers.

mods.name: dep-sentinel
mods.description: Checks each package the model installs against its registry and OSV.dev, and stops a missing, brand-new, look-alike, outdated or vulnerable one, naming the latest version.

mods.name: desk-notify
mods.description: Sends a desktop notification when a question or a plan waits for your answer, and when a turn ends or fails.

mods.name: diagram-render
mods.description: Renders the mermaid blocks of the model's replies with an installed mmdc after each turn and draws each picture under its reply.

mods.name: disk-janitor
mods.description: Measures the build artifacts of the repository, shows them on the status line from 5 GB, and deletes the ones you pick in the /disk-janitor pane; data directories are never listed.

mods.name: doc-drift-watch
mods.description: After each commit the model makes, adds the doc lines that commit made stale (file:line references, symbol names) to the commit's result, from ripwire doc-drift, and holds each finding open until the doc holds again.

mods.name: edit-loop
mods.description: Adds a note to the fifth edit of one file in one turn, so the model re-reads the code path and states the root cause instead of trying again.

mods.name: effort-auto
mods.description: Has a small model rate how hard each prompt is and runs that turn and its subagents at the matching effort, within the levels you allow, on the models whose prompt cache survives an effort change.

mods.name: env-sync
mods.description: After each commit the model makes, names the env variables its added lines read that .env.example lacks, with the file and line of each.

mods.name: error-poke
mods.description: Sends one continue prompt after a turn an API error killed, so the half-done work carries on instead of the session going idle, at most 99 times in a row by default.

mods.name: flaky-memory
mods.description: Remembers which tests failed on which code, and tells the model when a failing test has both passed and failed on the same code, so it runs the test again instead of changing code.

mods.name: gemini-advisor
mods.description: Gives the model a Gemini advisor tool it calls by itself: Gemini reads the whole conversation and the model's message and answers with a second opinion. Off until /gemini-advisor on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

mods.name: gemini-compact
mods.description: Moves compaction from Claude to Gemini: in summary mode Gemini summarizes the conversation and the newest messages stay verbatim, in prune mode every message stays and Gemini keeps, cuts or drops older tool calls. Off until /gemini-compact on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking lev…

mods.name: gemini-core
mods.description: Keeps the Gemini keys and tier of every Gemini mod, and each mod's model and thinking level, in one place: adds $.gemini, which builds their Gemini requests, reads the answers and moves to the next key after a quota or key error, and picks a model from Google's list.

mods.name: gemini-plan-review
mods.description: Has Gemini review each plan before the approval dialog, from the plan and the conversation, and sends a plan with a blocking finding back to the model, at most twice. Off until /gemini-plan-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

mods.name: gemini-review
mods.description: Has Gemini review every git commit the model runs, from the staged diff and the conversation, and stops a commit with a blocking finding: a bug, data loss, a security hole or a committed secret. Off until /gemini-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

mods.name: git-commit
mods.description: Ships a commit skill and holds every Bash git commit to it: a commit the skill did not open, a blanket git add, a signature trailer, a secret, an ignored path, or a push or branch change nobody asked for is stopped before git runs.

mods.name: i18n-watch
mods.description: After an edit that calls translation keys, names the keys the JSON, Laravel PHP, YAML or gettext locale files lack, and the languages that lack them.

mods.name: idle-art
mods.description: Draws an ASCII animation above the prompt while the model works: matrix rain, fire, an aquarium, a cat, or a GIF of your own imported as a character clip for every project. Display only: nothing reaches the model.

mods.name: limit-watch
mods.description: Shows the subscription usage limits under the prompt or in the shared sidebar with a reset countdown and a projection, opens a /limit-watch pane, logs once when a limit passes 80% and 95%, and stops sampling entirely with /limit-watch off.

mods.name: lockfile-sync
mods.description: After each commit the model makes, names the manifests whose dependencies it changed without their lockfile (npm, Composer, Cargo, Go, Python, Bundler, Dart, Mix).

mods.name: mcp-doctor
mods.description: Tells you when an MCP server failed to connect or dropped, with the engine's reason and a reconnect button, and when it is back; claude.ai connectors are left out.

mods.name: memory-save
mods.description: Loads MEMORY.md into the session and saves project learnings to it after every turn through a tool-less fork in the background, without blocking the stop.

mods.name: mod-doctor
mods.description: Names each installed plugin, of every marketplace, whose local clone already offers a newer version, with the claude plugin update command that closes the gap.

mods.name: orphan-server
mods.description: Lists the servers a Bash call of the model started in this repository and left listening on a port, with their age and session, and stops one with SIGTERM, then SIGKILL.

mods.name: output-flood
mods.description: Measures how much context each Bash command spent and tells the model, past a size limit, which narrower command would have answered the same question.

mods.name: pin-note
mods.description: Keeps the notes you pin with /pin-note for the whole session and sends them to the model again, word for word, after each compaction and /clear. Off until /pin-note on.

mods.name: probe-runner
mods.description: For mod development: runs a live check of plugins in a fresh Claude Code session in tmux, types the steps one by one, collects the pane and the transcript, then deletes the temp directory, its transcripts and the inline store files.

mods.name: prompt-deck
mods.description: Learns the short prompts you send often in this project and draws them, with the ones you pin by hand, above the prompt; with the prompt box empty, a digit key sends one at once.

mods.name: prompt-offload
mods.description: Writes a prompt longer than the limit (2000 characters by default) to a temp file and sends the model its first 200 characters with the path, so one paste does not fill the context.

mods.name: prompt-time
mods.description: Draws the time under each of your messages and each text block of the model's replies, also for a resumed session whose transcript is 4 MiB or smaller. Display only: nothing reaches the model.

mods.name: sage-memory
mods.description: Keeps project and global memories in SQLite through a shared local daemon, hands the model the entries that match its file tool calls, prompts and subagent tasks, and saves new ones with a haiku consolidator after each main-loop turn.

mods.name: self-command
mods.description: For mod development: lets the model run a slash command in its own session, such as /reload-plugins after a plugin update, and read the output as the next prompt.

mods.name: session-watch
mods.description: Shows this session's state in the sidebar: context fill, token totals, cost, model and effort, the Claude Code version, the other sessions of this machine, and the git branch and status.

mods.name: shot-inline
mods.description: Draws each PNG or JPG the model saves or reads under its tool row: pixels in kitty and Ghostty, quadrant block cells in every other terminal.

mods.name: sidebar
mods.description: Opens one shared pane beside the transcript and draws the sections, lines and buttons every other mod writes into it through $.sidebar; each stream entry is stamped with its time and kept in a per-project log the next session takes back.

mods.name: slash-chain
mods.description: Runs slash commands joined with && one after another, waits for each command's turn, pane or dialog to end, and stops the chain at a command that failed or a turn that ended without an answer.

mods.name: sql-concat-watch
mods.description: After an edit that builds SQL by joining or interpolating strings, names each line, so the model passes the values as query parameters.

mods.name: storage-guard
mods.description: After an edit that keeps browser data in localStorage or sessionStorage, names each line, so the model stores the data in a cookie instead.

mods.name: subagent-ledger
mods.description: Shows each subagent of the session with its turns, time, model and tokens, the costliest first, yellow while it runs and green once it answered, and marks one that passed the token limit.

mods.name: task-poke
mods.description: Submits a continue prompt while the task list has unfinished tasks, at most 99 times in a row by default, and turns the task tools on for every model unless CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS is set.

mods.name: tool-coach
mods.description: Stops the model from repeating a tool call that just failed with the same input, until a file or command has changed something.

mods.name: ua-fallback
mods.description: After a curl or wget an automated-client filter answered 403 or 429, gives the model the browser User-Agent to retry with, and the two cases where it must not.

mods.name: flowpane
mods.description: A live workflow pane: replaces the default Workflow progress list with a phase-by-phase graph or a timeline beside the transcript, showing each agent's state, timing, live token spend, tool calls, what it is saying, and prompt.

mods.name: commonplace
mods.description: LLM-maintained knowledge base for Obsidian vaults. Auto-triggers on paper sharing, vault health queries, concept compilation, research questions, and domain management.

mods.name: wire
mods.description: The Wire Framework — AI-accelerated data platform delivery for the full lifecycle: requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, enablement

mods.name: sn
mods.description: ServiceNow CLI wrapper — table CRUD, change management, CMDB, attachments, service catalog, import sets, CI reconciliation, CICD, aggregates, and schema discovery

mods.name: aicq
mods.description: AICQ for Claude Code: your agents and friends' agents, their collaborations and what needs you. Notices messages without heartbeats, drafts or responds per your policy, shares files, connects new agents.

mods.name: eklavya
mods.description: Learn while your agent works. Turns coding-agent generation time into adaptive, Socratic learning grounded in the code being written.

mods.name: mods-toolbox
mods.description: Mods Toolbox - Function-hook mods (Claude Code 2.1.291+): Clean View, a calm checklist above the prompt for non-technical users that hides tool calls, diffs and command output while showing the plan, the current step and its progress; the Agent Dock, which splits each request across a chosen team o…

mods.name: pinboard
mods.description: Keeps open decisions, the task list and links Claude creates in a sidebar pane, updated through its own tool

mods.name: agent-diet
mods.description: Runs search-only subagents (Explore by default) on Haiku instead of your main model; a model Claude asks for still wins, and /agent-diet picks the types and the model.

mods.name: answer-pane
mods.description: Explain, plan and ELI5 pages drawn natively in a side pane: diagrams in place, plan decisions as buttons, Respond fills the prompt box. No model calls.

mods.name: budget-guard
mods.description: Holds a prompt back once your 5-hour or weekly usage is at or over a limit you set (90% by default); sending it again goes through. No tokens spent.

mods.name: cache-clock
mods.description: Shows how long the prompt cache stays warm, and when it expires, exactly how many tokens your next message will re-send uncached. No tokens spent.

mods.name: cmd-diet
mods.description: Adds quiet flags to noisy shell commands before they run (git status, pytest, cargo, npm install, mvn, curl, wget, docker pull), so Claude reads short output from the start; errors, failures and warnings stay in full.

mods.name: collision-guard
mods.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another chat on this machine changed in the last 30 minutes. Each chat keeps its own small ledger; no model calls, no network.

mods.name: compact-keeper
mods.description: After a compaction, adds one message with exact facts from before it: your latest prompt in full, up to 4 earlier ones, the files edited, the todo list and the last failed shell command. At most 4,000 characters. No model calls.

mods.name: context-xray
mods.description: A pane with the exact breakdown of what fills Claude's context: system prompt, tools, memory files, skills, messages, and which tools load on every request.

mods.name: gh-account
mods.description: Runs each git push, pull, fetch, clone and gh command as the logged-in GitHub account that owns or belongs to the repository's owner, so Claude stops switching gh accounts and retrying failed pushes.

mods.name: kit-updates
mods.description: Tells you when a newer version of an installed claude-pro-kit mod is out, and /kit-update installs it along with any new mods you never had. One small download per session, no tokens spent.

mods.name: loop-guard
mods.description: Holds back a shell command once when the exact same command already failed twice in a row, and tells Claude to change approach; retrying it still goes through.

mods.name: nudge
mods.description: /nudge <goal> applies behavioral design to a product or flow: diagnose why users don't act, design interventions that remove barriers, ranked hypotheses to test, and an ethics check on every answer. Its guide reaches Claude only when you run /nudge.

mods.name: output-diet
mods.description: Trims long shell output, Grep results and subagent reports before Claude reads them (head, tail and error lines kept); the untrimmed text is saved to a file Claude can open.

mods.name: peek
mods.description: Typing "status" while background shells or subagents run opens a pane with each task's exact elapsed time, the tail of its output and any percent it printed, instead of sending the prompt to Claude. /peek opens it too. No tokens spent.

mods.name: pro-hud
mods.description: Desktop heads-up display for the Pro plan: exact 5h/7d usage gauges, context gauge, turn receipts, usage in the spinner and compact tool cards. No estimates, no tokens spent.

mods.name: prompt-polish
mods.description: An Improve button above the prompt (and /polish) rewrites your draft with Opus at low effort (/polish model picks another) using the prompt-master rules (MIT, nidhinjs/prompt-master); Undo puts the original back. Each press is one model call; its exact tokens are shown.

mods.name: read-cap
mods.description: Stops Claude reading a file over 1,000 lines whole (with Read, cat or Get-Content) and gives it an outline tool (definitions with line numbers) so it reads only the range it needs. A retry still reads it whole.

mods.name: reread-guard
mods.description: Stops Claude re-reading a file it already read in this conversation, with Read or a plain cat, sed -n, head, tail or Get-Content, when the file has not changed since; a deliberate second attempt still goes through.

mods.name: session-receipt
mods.description: /receipt opens a pane with the exact tokens every turn of the session spent (uncached, cached, output, subagents) and the costliest turns. No tokens spent.

mods.name: skill-diet
mods.description: Lists skills you have not used lately in this project by name only, so their descriptions stop riding along on every request; the Skill tool and /name still load any of them. No model calls.

mods.name: tool-diet
mods.description: Moves tools you have not used lately behind ToolSearch, so their descriptions stop riding along on every request; core tools and anything you used in your last five sessions stay loaded.

mods.name: turn-budget
mods.description: When one turn uses more than +5 session points or 500,000 uncached input tokens, writes a handoff from exact session data and copies it for a new session; the old session is never cleared. No model calls.

mods.name: write-guard
mods.description: Steers Claude to Edit instead of rewriting an existing file in full with Write: the first rewrite in a conversation goes through with a one-line note, a later one is held back once; a deliberate retry still goes through.

mods.name: clawd-buddy
mods.description: Clawd, Claude Code's pixel mascot, lives above your prompt in the terminal and the desktop app: it acts out what Claude is doing, chats with you, dances to your music, plays a runner game, and in the desktop app idles in a little pixel San Francisco

mods.name: budget-guard
mods.description: Stops a session before it runs past a budget. Three figures are guarded, each with a limit you set: the session cost in dollars, the 5-hour plan window and the 7-day plan window. It says nothing until a figure nears its limit, then pins a status line and warns once; past the limit it refuses tool c…

mods.name: context-lens
mods.description: A live /context: a pinned line under the prompt with the window fill and the growth per turn, and /context-lens for a pane with the per-category bars and how many turns are left before auto-compaction.

mods.name: quota-meter
mods.description: Shows the subscription plan limits - the 5-hour window, the 7-day window and a gateway spend limit - as a pinned status line under the prompt, with a reset countdown and a projection of when you would hit 100% at the pace of the last few samples. /quota opens a pane with a bar, the reset clock time…

mods.name: token-ledger
mods.description: A per-turn cost and token ledger: a pinned status line with the session cost, the last turn's tokens and the cache hit ratio, and /ledger for a table of the recent turns with their model, tokens, cache reads and writes, duration and cost.

mods.name: taxi-blackbox
mods.description: Claude의 도구 호출을 블랙박스처럼 녹화: 오류·거부(사고) 직전 동작을 /blackbox에서 돌려보기, 토큰·비밀번호는 가려서 기록

mods.name: taxi-meter
mods.description: 프롬프트 위 택시 미터기 패널: 세션 요금(API 정가 환산)과 방금 요청 요금, 모델 이름·차종·할증 키, 5시간·주간 한도와 리셋 시각, /meter·/receipt

mods.description: Runs bd prime once per session and adds its text (max 8 KB) to the system prompt, from the repo's .beads files and bd memories. bd setup claude hooks may add it twice.

mods.name: branch-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the git branch and the count of changed files, read with git status after each Bash call and file edit.

mods.name: branches
mods.description: Adds /branches: local branches merged into the default branch or idle for 30 days, as a cleanup list, read with git. Never deletes. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: break-nudge
mods.description: Suggests a short break once the session has run 90 minutes, and again every 90 minutes after that.

mods.name: bullet-mode
mods.description: Replies as short bullet lists, at most one sentence per bullet, unless you ask for code.

mods.name: cache-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the share of prompt tokens the cache served this session (cache 87%). A high share means cheaper, faster turns.

mods.name: changelog
mods.description: Adds /changelog: commits since the last tag (or the last 30), read with git log and grouped by conventional-commit type, as Markdown. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: chmod-guard
mods.description: Asks before chmod makes files world-writable (777, a+w, o+w) or chmod or chown runs recursively on a broad path (/, a system folder, a home folder).

mods.name: ci-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (ci passed, ci failed, ci running), asked of the gh CLI every 2 minutes; branch read with git. Hidden without gh.

mods.name: clippy
mods.description: One helpful toast per session per trigger, in the classic paperclip voice: when you edit a migrations folder, a Dockerfile or a GitHub workflow, or run rm -rf. At most one toast per turn.

mods.name: code-only
mods.description: Replies with the code or command first and at most two short sentences of prose, unless asked to explain.

mods.name: commit-msg
mods.description: Adds /commit-msg: a Conventional Commits message proposed from the staged diff, read with git. Heuristic, no model call, writes nothing. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: conflicts
mods.description: Adds /conflicts: tracked files that still hold merge conflict markers, with line numbers, found with git grep. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: cost-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the session cost so far and what the last turn cost.

mods.name: cost-pane
mods.description: A live side pane with the session cost, the cost of each of the last 10 turns as a bar, and the average per turn. Open it with /cost-pane.

mods.name: cron-guard
mods.description: Asks before scheduled jobs or services are wiped or stopped: crontab -r, crontab replaced from stdin or a file, launchctl unload or bootout, systemctl stop, disable or mask.

mods.name: ctx-nudge
mods.description: Reminds you to /clear or /compact when the context window passes 75 percent.

mods.name: daily-spend
mods.description: A band above the prompt with today's total cost across all your sessions.

mods.name: deps
mods.description: Adds /deps: direct dependencies with versions from package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, go.mod and Cargo.toml at the repo root. No network. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: dev-band
mods.description: The developer band in one row above the prompt: git branch and changed files (read with git status), wall clock and session age, tool counts, and failed tool calls.

mods.name: diff-stats
mods.description: Edit and Write rows show a compact +12 -3 bar beside the file name: green for lines added, red for lines removed, up to 20 cells.

mods.name: docs-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when edits added exported code (an export statement in .ts or .js, or a public function signature) and no README or docs file was edited this session.

mods.name: eli5-mode
mods.description: Explains like the reader is new: analogies first, no jargon without a one-line definition.

mods.name: env-check
mods.description: Adds /env-check: variable names in .env.example against .env at the git repo root, listing missing and extra names. Reads names only, never a value. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: envinfo
mods.description: Adds /envinfo: versions of git, node, npm, python3, go, rustc and docker if installed, by running each (2 s limit), and the OS. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: epic-bar
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the progress of the epic you work on, or of the open epic nearest to done (bm-ooq ███████░ 7/8), read with bd. Hidden without epics or bd.

mods.name: epics-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of each open beads epic: a bar of closed and total children, and a mark when it is ready to close. Read with bd, read-only. Open it with /epics.

mods.name: error-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how many tool calls failed this session (an error or a deny) and which tool failed last. Red from the first failure.

mods.name: exit-badge
mods.description: A failed Bash row shows a small red badge with its exit code, for example exit 2.

mods.name: file-links
mods.description: In Claude's replies, path/to/file.ts:42 references to files in your project become links. Click one to put @path/to/file.ts in the prompt.

mods.name: file-owners
mods.description: Adds /owners <path>: the top 5 authors of a file or folder by lines, from git blame. Names only, never addresses. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: files-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of the files Claude read, edited or wrote this session, grouped by action with a count per file, newest first. Open it with /files.

mods.name: focus-pack
mods.description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: commit after 8 edits, TODO/FIXME/HACK lines added, and debug prints added.

mods.name: fun-pack
mods.description: Fun habits in one install: caveman prose and gitmoji commit messages. They compose: caveman never touches commit messages.

mods.name: git-pane
mods.description: A live side pane, read with git: the branch, ahead and behind its upstream, changed files (staged and unstaged) and the last 5 commits. Refreshes after git commands and edits. Open it with /git.

mods.name: guard-pack
mods.description: The 15 core Baselane guards in one mod (secrets, git, infra, packages, path jail). Some read git, measure files with find, read HOME with printenv, or check where a path really lands.

mods.name: handoff
mods.description: Adds /handoff: writes a session summary with the git status to .claude/handoff.md (never overwriting) and answers with the path. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: heatmap
mods.description: Adds /heatmap: a 12-week calendar grid of the days you used Claude Code, like a contribution graph, shaded by turns, naming your busiest day.

mods.name: hotspots
mods.description: Adds /hotspots: the 10 files changed most often in the last 90 days, from git log, with change counts. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: infra-guard
mods.description: Asks before terraform destroy, kubectl delete, force-push, DROP TABLE or rm -rf.

mods.name: issue-links
mods.description: #123 references in Claude's replies become links to that issue when the repository's origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

mods.name: k8s-guard
mods.description: Asks before kubectl apply or replace with --force, kubectl drain, helm uninstall, and kubectl delete behind global flags (plain kubectl delete is infra-guard's).

mods.name: langs
mods.description: Counts the file types Claude edits across sessions and adds /langs: a bar list of the types edited most, each file counted once per session.

mods.name: licenses
mods.description: Adds /licenses: the licence of each direct dependency, from node_modules and Python dist-info at the git repo root. Shows unknown when it cannot tell. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: loc
mods.description: Adds /loc: lines of tracked text files by language, read with git, sorted, with a total. Skips lockfiles and binaries. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: mood-ring
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a colored dot and a word for the error and block rate of your last 20 tool calls: calm (green) under 10 percent, tense (yellow) under 30, stormy (red) from 30.

mods.name: night-owl
mods.description: Records the hour of each prompt across sessions and adds /hours: a 24-hour histogram of when you work, naming your peak hour.

mods.name: no-em-dash
mods.description: Never writes the em-dash character. Uses a comma, colon, period or parentheses.

mods.name: noir-mode
mods.description: Prose like a hard-boiled detective narrator, light and clear. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

mods.name: nudge-pack
mods.description: Two turn-end reminders in one mod: test-reminder and ctx-nudge.

mods.name: ops-band
mods.description: The ops band in one row above the prompt: commits ahead and behind the upstream (git), the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (gh), and the Mac battery (pmset).

mods.name: path-jail
mods.description: Asks before Write, Edit or NotebookEdit changes a file outside the working directory, by real path.

mods.name: pomodoro
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a 25/5 focus timer (focus 18:42, break 03:10). Start and stop it with /pomodoro; a toast marks each switch.

mods.name: port-watch
mods.description: A live side pane of the local TCP ports that listen, with the process name and pid, refreshed every 10 seconds while open. Reads lsof (macOS, most Linux). Open it with /ports.

mods.name: ready
mods.description: Adds /ready: the 20 top ready beads, one line each, and the total. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

mods.name: receipt
mods.description: Adds /receipt: a shareable receipt of the session (tools, files, commands, blocks, context, cost), printed and copied.

mods.name: recent
mods.description: Adds /recent: your last 15 commits across all local branches (author is git user.name), with branch and date. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: repo-pack
mods.description: Five read-only repo commands in one mod: /todos, /loc, /hotspots, /commit-msg and /branches. They read git. They copy results to the clipboard.

mods.name: say-done
mods.description: On macOS, speaks "Claude is done" with the say command when a turn ends after more than 30 seconds. Does nothing on other platforms.

mods.name: scripts
mods.description: Adds /scripts: runnable tasks from package.json scripts, Makefile targets, justfile recipes and pyproject scripts at the git repo root. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: sha-links
mods.description: Commit SHAs in Claude's replies, and in the output of git commands, become links to the commit page when origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

mods.name: size
mods.description: Adds /size: the 15 largest tracked files and the total tracked size at HEAD, read with git. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: size-badge
mods.description: Read and Write rows show how much was read or written: the line count, for example 312 lines, or the file size for images and PDFs.

mods.name: sounds-zen
mods.description: Soft bells and singing-bowl tones: a bell when tests pass, a low bowl when they fail, a muted chime when a call is blocked, a bowl when a turn ends.

mods.name: ssh-guard
mods.description: Asks before a private key in .ssh is read, authorized_keys or the SSH config is changed, or ssh-keygen would overwrite a key. Public keys and ssh -i pass. Reads HOME with printenv.

mods.name: standup
mods.description: Adds /standup: Yesterday, Today and Blockers from your git log and this session's record, printed and copied.

mods.name: stashes
mods.description: Adds /stashes: git stashes with their age and the branch each was made on. Read-only, never applies or drops. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: stats-pack
mods.description: The three original stats mods in one: /wrapped (copied to your clipboard), streaks and achievements on one shared daily rollup.

mods.name: ste-mode
mods.description: Replies in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: approved words, short sentences, one instruction each, active voice.

mods.name: streaks
mods.description: Counts consecutive days you used Claude Code: a Day N streak toast at session start, and /streak to ask.

mods.name: sudo-guard
mods.description: Asks before sudo, doas or su -c runs a command with elevated rights.

mods.name: tag-guard
mods.description: Asks before release tags go to a remote: git push --tags, --follow-tags or --mirror, a push of a tag ref, and a push that deletes a remote tag. Dry runs pass. Reads tags with git.

mods.name: tdd-mode
mods.description: Writes a failing test first, watches it fail, then implements.

mods.name: team-pack
mods.description: Team habits in one install: Conventional Commits, test-first work and a security check on every change.

mods.name: terse-mode
mods.description: Short answers: no preamble, no recap.

mods.name: test-pane
mods.description: A live side pane with the last test run (vitest, jest, pytest, go test, cargo test, bun test, claude plugin test): runner, pass, fail and skip counts, duration and first failures. Open it with /tests.

mods.name: time-badge
mods.description: Tool rows show how long the call ran, for example 2.4s, when it took over one second. The time is the tool's own run time, without permission prompts.

mods.name: todo-count
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how many lines in tracked files hold TODO, FIXME or HACK (todo 12), counted with git after edits. Hidden when there are none.

mods.name: todo-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast with the count of TODO, FIXME and HACK lines your edits added this turn. Quiet when none were added.

mods.name: todo-pane
mods.description: A live side pane of the TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files (git grep), grouped by file and capped at 30. It refreshes after file edits while open. Open it with /todo-pane.

mods.name: todos
mods.description: Adds /todos: TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files, found with git grep, grouped by file (50 lines at most). Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: tree
mods.description: Adds /tree: tracked files (git ls-files) as a tree, 2 levels deep, folders with file counts (80 lines at most). Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

mods.name: turn-timer
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how long the current turn has run (turn 0:42). It shows while a turn runs and hides between turns.

mods.name: url-links
mods.description: https links (and http://localhost) in tool output are listed as clickable links under the result, up to five. Display only: Claude reads the output as it was.

mods.name: weekly
mods.description: Adds /week: this week (since Monday) against last week, with sessions, turns, tool calls, files edited and cost, and the change for each.

mods.name: wrapped
mods.description: Adds /wrapped: a screenshot-ready Claude Code Wrapped for the last 7 days (or /wrapped month for 30), printed and copied.

mods.name: yoda-mode
mods.description: Speaks like Yoda in prose. Code, commands and commit messages stay normal.

mods.name: hud
mods.description: A CRT-style status panel above or below the prompt: model, project and git, context with a compact button, plan usage, prompt cache, cost and running tools. /hud toggles it.

mods.name: live-recap
mods.description: A card above the prompt that says what Claude is working on, refreshed every few minutes while a turn runs

mods.name: message-timestamps
mods.description: Prefixes each Claude reply in the transcript with the local time it arrived, with no model calls

mods.name: usage-band
mods.description: Shows context window fill and plan usage limits in a band above the prompt.

mods.name: idle-compact
mods.description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache expires, so returning does not re-write the full context

mods.name: korkmaz-trail
mods.description: An audit trail for your AI agent, above the Claude Code prompt: commands, file changes, outbound calls and risky actions next to your plan limits, context and cost.

mods.name: nyan-cat
mods.description: Nyan Cat flies with its rainbow above the prompt while Claude works. /nyan changes its size or turns it off.

mods.name: bitranox
mods.description: Bitranox skill collection: software-engineering workflow skills (planning, debugging, code review, clean architecture, language and tool references, humanizing) plus a self-improvement loop that captures session learnings into memory and CLAUDE.md, and PostToolUse hooks that validate JSON/YAML/XML…

mods.name: byj-statusline
mods.description: A status band above the prompt that looks like it shipped with Claude Code: model and effort, session, git, a live context gauge, 5h/7d usage with pace marks, the prompt cache countdown, and a live line of tools, subagents and tasks while Claude works. Hover any part for details; click a name to co…

mods.name: cliamp
mods.description: cliamp radio in Claude Code: sidebar with favorites, search and discovery, mini player, song log, focus mode, ducking and a radio tool for Claude

mods.name: codex-imagegen
mods.description: Adds a generate_image tool: Claude hands image requests to the local Codex (ChatGPT) CLI and gets back the saved file.

mods.name: pixel-buddy
mods.description: A pixel Claude critter above the prompt that reacts to typing, working, finishing and going AFK.

mods.name: project-box
mods.description: A folder-tree card beside the status bar listing your projects by category, read from ~/.claude/project-box.json.

mods.name: statusbar
mods.description: Status bar above the prompt: working/idle, tool count, last tool, last turn duration.

mods.name: tristens-tools
mods.description: Tools menu for Claude Code: Clean View, Prompt Upgrade, model/effort control panel, Agent Dock, Roadtrip minigame.

mods.name: rich-replies
mods.description: Claude Code terminal mod: TL;DR boxes, foldable sections, ▶ run for shell blocks, tool badges with error lines and stack links, a read-only SQL console, a REST client, a JSON tree, lint after edits, and /changes, /pr, /exec. Everything is off until you turn it on.

mods.name: loadout
mods.description: Mod manager for Claude Code: audits every mod and every update before it runs, keeps your own changes across updates, and shows what each mod's code can really do.

mods.name: prototype-mode
mods.description: Flag a project for prototype mode: no git worktrees, iterate and commit directly on the current branch (main included). Works for background jobs too.

mods.name: worktree-terminal
mods.description: Open a terminal in the session's worktree or any agent's worktree: /term, or the buttons above the prompt

mods.name: cockpit
mods.description: Progress bars from your todo list at zero extra tokens, a router where you pick the model and effort for quick, normal and hard prompts, and a prompt-cache meter that can keep the cache warm

mods.name: lens
mods.description: Review a repo's changes in a pane: the changed files with editor-style diagnostics (pyright, ruff, tsc, eslint, terraform), a diff view, a git graph, commits and stashes, and pull request comments. Run /lens [folder] [base].

mods.name: tangents
mods.description: Go off on a tangent about any paragraph of Claude's replies, kept out of the main context until you promote it

mods.name: auto-docs
mods.description: After each commit this session makes, reads the diff and updates README.md (or the docs you list) with small, safe edits in a follow-up docs commit.

mods.name: next-steps
mods.description: After each real turn, suggests 1-3 next prompts in a pane of their own: tick any number and insert them into the prompt box together. The text sent for the suggestion is scrubbed of personal data (IDs, phones, emails, cards).

mods.name: token-ledger
mods.description: Your 5-hour, weekly, context and cache-hit figures as one line above the prompt, a ? button that asks Haiku 5.5 for questions to ask next, and a /ledger pane with subagent shares. Percentages only, no money.

mods.name: burnrate
mods.description: Full mod: live limits band above the prompt plus the guard (cache watchdog and limit brake).

mods.name: limit-guard
mods.description: Warns when the prompt cache is invalidated; near the 5h cap blocks subagents and wide scans and asks Claude for short answers.

mods.name: limits-band
mods.description: Band above the prompt: 5h/7d limits with reset timers, context fill, cache hit rate and what fills your context.

mods.name: auto-model
mods.description: Picks the model for each turn from how hard your prompt looks: haiku, sonnet, opus or fable, with high thinking effort on every tier by default.

mods.name: prompt-upgrade
mods.description: Turns a rough prompt into a clear one right in the chat: a few multiple-choice questions, like plan mode, then the upgraded prompt is sent for you.

mods.name: git-graph
mods.description: A vscode-git-graph style commit graph pane for Claude Code: switch branches, checkout commits, create/rename/delete tags and push them

mods.name: incremental
mods.description: /incremental: the Claude mascot mines a rock for ore; every ore is tokens

mods.name: jev-suite
mods.description: Branch git acima do prompt e juízos do Jev (TypeSafe): guarda de comandos, roteador de esforço, detector de segredos, aviso de agente travado, dica de qualidade do prompt e triagem de saídas

mods.name: status-pills
mods.description: A band of pills under the prompt: model and effort, context, the 5-hour and 7-day limits with their resets, project and branch

mods.name: copy-command
mods.description: An icon-only copy button beside every shell command in Claude's replies.

mods.name: open-link
mods.description: Kitty-style hints mode: label every link in view, press a key to open it in the default browser.

mods.name: pr-watch
mods.description: Above the prompt: the branch PR with its checks and failing log lines, uncommitted work with a commit-and-push key, and how far the branch is behind the default branch with a rebase key. The branch name sits in the hint line.

mods.name: ironman

mods.name: decisions
mods.description: Tracks open decisions Claude raises in a side pane so you can answer them against a reference while work continues

mods.name: sotto
mods.description: Full-duplex voice conversation with your running Claude Code session, powered by OpenAI gpt-live-1. Toggle with /talk.

mods.name: consumo
mods.description: Panel de consumo de tu suscripción con historial, predicción, tokens, precio y consumo por turno, modo ahorro automático y una mascota que reacciona a lo que hace Claude y a sus subagentes

mods.name: latex-render
mods.description: Draws display LaTeX ($$...$$ or \[...\]) in assistant replies as typeset images (tectonic + kitty graphics)

mods.name: usage-band
mods.description: Context window and subscription-limit usage (5-hour, weekly) above the prompt

mods.name: model-spinners
mods.description: Spinner verbs that match how smart the current model + effort level is

mods.name: doom
mods.description: The original Doom engine, with Freedoom Phase 1, playable inside Claude Code. Run /doom.

mods.name: consumo
mods.description: Mide, gestiona y controla el trabajo, y el control escucha lo medido: el panel y la orden del próximo despertar salen de la foto del index (cuellos de botella, quién está en qué, flujo con sus n), no de un cálculo aparte. mods.name: pixel-player
mods.description: A pixel-art music player pane that streams a playlist through mpv

mods.name: clarity
mods.description: A clearer Claude Code terminal: boxed and organized you/claude conversations, colour-coded clickable tool rows, a live status band with a timer and task info, a session panel, copy buttons, cards, alerts, readable palettes, and overall transforms Claude Code.

mods.name: auto-model
mods.description: Picks the right model for each prompt you type, quietly, when switched on.

mods.name: command-deck
mods.description: One band above the prompt: session, git, context and plan-limit meters, cost, and your mods, model and effort controls.

mods.name: dev-server
mods.description: A /dev command and pane that start, stop and restart the project's dev server (its package.json dev script) and show its output.

mods.name: github-issues
mods.description: A /issues pane listing the repo's open GitHub issues; click one to open it, or send it to the prompt.

mods.name: prompt-upgrade
mods.description: Turns a rough prompt into a better one before it is sent: a few quick questions, a rewrite, and a side-by-side review.

mods.name: todo-list
mods.description: Keeps a running list of open items from the conversation and shows it above the prompt.

mods.name: deep-space
mods.description: A deep-space themed Claude Code: space verbs, a starfield with a pixel mascot, local Spotify controls and a violet palette.

mods.name: mascot-studio
mods.description: A 2010s animation studio in your terminal: Clawd acts out what Claude is doing, with usage and music tabs and Windows 7, Mac OS X and Ubuntu themes.

mods.name: cc-fm-mod
mods.description: claude.fm in your prompt: a live spectrum under the composer and /fm to control the cc-fm player, local or over SSH

mods.name: codecycle
mods.description: Fester, wiederholbarer Arbeitsablauf für Claude Code: Befehle (new, continue, status, setup, ideas, check, update), Rollen-Agenten, Projekt-Werkzeug und optionaler Mod (Statuszeile, Bautafel, Seitenleiste, /profile).

mods.name: skills-band
mods.description: One-row skills band above the prompt: theme-colored labels, Claude-orange dots on active skills and caveman/ponytail modes

mods.name: clima-condor
mods.description: Clima, sol y luna reales, marea, huracanes y relojes en un panel de Claude Code: /clima

mods.name: lk-agent-map
mods.description: See and cap your subagents: cards with cost, tokens, context and progress, spawn caps with an override you approve, tree and team views, idle alerts and a Stop button.

mods.name: lk-attention

mods.name: lk-handoff-guard

mods.name: lk-pr-watch

mods.name: lk-secret-guard

mods.name: lk-where-am-i

mods.name: blast-radius
mods.description: Stops destructive commands and shows exactly what they would delete until you press Proceed

mods.name: file-tree
mods.description: A file tree pane that shimmers on files Claude touches and turns them green once committed

mods.name: reflect
mods.description: Spots corrective feedback and offers to save it as a permanent rule in CLAUDE.md or a skill

mods.name: savvy-progress
mods.description: Progress bar above the prompt and a live pane of subagents with model, progress and cost

mods.name: terminal-browser

mods.name: you-should-know

mods.name: centinela

mods.name: dieta

mods.name: progreso

mods.name: subagentes

mods.name: traspaso
mods.description: Cierre ordenado antes de quedarse sin contexto, sin cuota o sin caché: escribe un documento de traspaso y el prompt para seguir en otra sesión, y avisa al móvil

mods.name: workhorse
mods.description: Hand coding, review and ops jobs to Codex as background subagents, with a live status band, watchdog warnings and completion notices

mods.name: jump-list
mods.description: A side pane listing every prompt in the session: see where you are, click to jump back

mods.name: prompt-boost

mods.name: reply-tools
mods.description: Copy buttons on code blocks and a one-click tl;dr of long replies

mods.name: agent-monitor
mods.description: A sidebar pane for Claude Code: live progress, pause/resume, stop and messaging for subagents and workflow agents, plus session spend and plan limits

mods.name: profiles
mods.description: Several Claude Code logins over one shared setup: the current profile under the prompt, a /profile picker to switch, and commands to create, edit and delete profiles

mods.name: activity
mods.description: A live crew panel: every agent, its model, effort, tokens and estimated cost, with a friendly pixel crab.

mods.name: chorus
mods.description: Browse a ship's chorus cabinet with /cabinet and sync trusted slips into project memory.

mods.name: taxi-meter
mods.description: A taxi meter in the status line: the session's cost ticks up live as tokens burn.

mods.name: screen-peek
mods.description: Live panel of the screenshots Claude sees from Playwright, image reads, and any MCP tool

mods.name: coach-on-call
mods.description: "코치 <대충 쓴 말>"로 부를 때만 프롬프트를 다듬어 준다. 다듬은 걸 보낼지, 내 말 그대로 보낼지, 고쳐서 보낼지 고른다.

mods.name: hq-usage

mods.name: next-steps-multi
mods.description: 답이 끝나면 다음 프롬프트를 최대 3개 제안한다. 1·2·3으로 여러 개를 체크하고 0으로 한꺼번에 입력창에 넣는다.

mods.name: pinboard
mods.description: Keeps open decisions, the task list and links Claude creates in a sidebar pane, updated through its own tool. sirkitree/pinboard 0.1.0 을 고쳐 패널을 45칸으로 열고, 다시 띄운 세션은 대화 기록의 마지막 보드로 되살린다.

mods.name: codebuddy
mods.description: 读取本机 CodeBuddy 登录信息，在底部状态区域显示剩余积分、总积分和今日用量

mods.name: shell-mode
mods.description: 用 /shell-mode 切换 Bash 模式，连续执行命令并显示颜色，退出后将输出保留在 CLI 中

mods.name: show-mode
mods.description: hidden 模式仅展示当前思考，回合结束清理临时显示，并保存文件 diff 与思考过程供回看；显式指定 off/hidden 切换

mods.name: cache-keeper
mods.description: Thanh gọn trên ô nhập: đếm ngược cache, context, quota 5h/tuần kèm giờ reset, chi phí phiên, gợi ý bước tiếp và nút handoff

mods.name: secret-guard
mods.description: Keeps API keys, tokens and passwords out of the transcript, tool output, files, commits, PRs and issues.

mods.name: clawd
mods.description: Clawd, Claude Code's pixel crab, walks above your prompt while Claude works. Click it to crack the whip.

mods.name: clawd-radio
mods.description: A one-row radio above your prompt with 54 stations, including Singapore's, played in the terminal.

mods.name: baton
mods.description: Context budget guard and handoff relay: measures real context use per model request, stops subagents that run too long or too big, and hands work over to a fresh session before the main agent drowns.

mods.name: cache-meter
mods.description: Band above the prompt: prompt-cache countdown, cache hit rate of the last request, context fill against auto-compact, and a Compact button.

mods.name: mod-switch
mods.description: A mods button in the prompt footer opens a popover of every installed mod with switches that enable or disable them at user scope.

mods.name: relay
mods.description: Role buttons above the prompt: check or adversarially review the working tree with Codex, hand a task over to Codex, or verify with a second Claude model. A pane streams the run and turns findings into fix prompts.

mods.name: better-btw
mods.description: Replaces /btw with a side-question pane you can keep asking follow-ups in

mods.name: better-rewind
mods.description: Rewind or summarize from any prompt, tool call or AskUserQuestion answer, with a reply preview and saved branches

mods.name: subagent-effort
mods.description: Run each subagent on any model (gpt-6, grok-4.7, ...) at any reasoning effort, through model and effort parameters on the Agent tool

mods.name: context-line
mods.description: One-line summary of the context window under the prompt: usage, window size and the top 5 categories.

mods.name: chat-roles
mods.description: Barre de couleur, étiquette et heure sur chaque message du flux : vous, Claude, autres sessions, monitors.

mods.name: jev-compact
mods.description: Context compaction that prunes instead of summarising: rules drop exploration output and hook noise locally, Jev ranks the rest against a budget, a note says what was removed, and removed outputs are archived for the brain. Falls back to the built-in summary when it cannot do better.

mods.name: jev-compact-trigger
mods.description: Companion to jev-compact: watches context use after every turn and starts a compaction at the configured percentage. Separate plugin on purpose — the engine skips a plugin's own session.compact hook when that plugin raises the compaction, so the trigger must come from outside jev-compact for the pr…

mods.name: clean-view
mods.description: A calm checklist above the prompt that hides tool rows, for people who are not technical.

mods.name: prompt-upgrade
mods.description: Turns a rough prompt into a clear one in a review pane before it is sent.

mods.name: playwright-claude-mod
mods.description: Playwright tests and results in a side panel

mods.name: blast-radius
mods.description: Catches risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, ...) before they run, forces a permission prompt, and shows what they would touch in a side pane.

mods.name: changed-files
mods.description: A live sidebar of every file Claude touched this session, with +/- line counts.

mods.name: codebase-atlas
mods.description: Understand a codebase visually: a live architecture map that lights up as Claude reads and edits, a call graph explorer, the session's changes by layer with their impact, a decision timeline, and side-question explanations that never enter your conversation. /atlas

mods.name: crew
mods.description: Agents side pane: every subagent as a little pixel crew member with its model, effort, context, tokens, cost and time; running, completed and planned tasks with their dependencies. /crew

mods.name: diff-minimap
mods.description: A thin minimap strip beside each Edit and Write in the transcript: green, red and yellow ticks show where in the file the change sits, like VS Code's scrollbar.

mods.name: fork-explorer
mods.description: Ask "what if..." in a side pane: a side question over the current session returns 2-3 alternative approaches side by side, without adding anything to your conversation.

mods.name: mission-control
mods.description: Live view of what Claude is executing: every tool call with its input, output and status, subagents in their own lanes, and a network-tab style timeline of durations. Observe-only.

mods.name: replay-theater
mods.description: Records every file edit Claude makes in a turn; /replay steps through the diffs one at a time in a docked pane.

mods.name: session-meter
mods.description: Status line meter: elapsed time, tool calls and files edited this session, plus a toast when a long turn finishes.

mods.name: usage-forecast
mods.description: A band above the prompt with your plan's 5-hour and weekly limits (how much is used, when each resets, and whether you are on pace to run out) plus a forecast for the context window. /forecast

mods.name: workbench
mods.description: One workspace for watching and understanding Claude's work: a one-line band above the prompt and a pane with Now, Changes (file diffstat, changed functions, highlighted diffs, replay), live Preview, Artifacts, Code Map and Usage. /wb

mods.name: decisioncritic
mods.description: Reviews Claude's observable decisions with a separate critic model and shows evidence-backed criticism cards you can accept, challenge, implement and verify.

mods.name: worktrace
mods.description: A persistent file tree and timeline of the files Claude reads, searches and changes, with summaries and exact diffs.

mods.name: run-cat
mods.description: Claude が考えている間、CLI のプロンプト下のヒント行で AA の猫が走る（端末だけで描く）

mods.name: token-weather
mods.description: コンテキストの使用状況を天気で、このセッションが読んだ auto-memory を一覧で、右のペインに示す。カードを押すと内訳・残り時間・索引の項目が開く

mods.name: prompt-cats
mods.description: Two pixel cats (bright golden and brown tabby) above the prompt: sitting while idle, walking in place while Claude works.

mods.name: cells
mods.description: Lets Claude make several edits and their check, or a language-server lookup or rename, in one step through the real tools; guidance on chaining, which a subagent's task carries too; and a short note when a step cost a model request of its own for nothing.

mods.name: delegate
mods.description: A hand_off tool: Claude gives a self-contained task to a cheaper worker model (Haiku) that stays warm between tasks, with where the change reaches from the language server, the diff and a check run by the tool as evidence, a review by the main model, and a log of what it saved and how often the wor…

mods.name: eta
mods.description: Shows long-running and background jobs with a percentage and an estimated finish time, read live from their output.

mods.name: lsp-plus
mods.description: Extends Claude Code's LSP: references and definitions name the docs that use a symbol, an edit that removes a name the docs still use says so, /refs finds stale code names and broken links in the docs, a grep for a code symbol gets a note naming the exact LSP call, and Markdown, SQL, shell scripts…

mods.name: modpack
mods.description: The claude-mods modpack: statusline, smart-compact, delegate, lsp-plus, cells, eta and seek, installed together and built to work together, and route, off until you turn it on.

mods.name: seek
mods.description: Has Claude look around your code in few, lean steps. Every request re-reads the whole conversation, and whatever Claude reads stays in it for every later request; so your prompt, and the task of a subagent Claude starts, carries your setting to batch the searches and reads Claude can already name,…

mods.name: smart-compact
mods.description: Keeps an idle session's prompt cache warm, or compacts it just before it expires, whichever is cheaper, and says on the status line whether the next prompt is ready or cold.

mods.name: statusline
mods.description: One line under the prompt: the model and its effort, how full the context is, the plan's 5-hour and 7-day use with their resets, and what other mods put on it (smart-compact's ready or cold).

mods.name: model-hint
mods.description: Suggests haiku, sonnet or opus for the task you are typing, live, in a band above the prompt. Instant word rules, then a small model reads the draft when you pause.

mods.name: claudomon
mods.description: A pixel pet that lives on your Claude Code screen, hatched from your project and reacting to everything Claude does

mods.name: awareness
mods.description: A Claude Code pane showing the model, thinking level, context, usage limits, git state, PR, running agents and your last three prompts.

mods.name: commit-erinnerung
mods.description: Läuft ein Testbefehl grün durch und liegen danach uncommittete Änderungen im Repo, bekommt Claude still einen Hinweis, den Arbeitsschritt zu committen. Keine Dauerabfrage, kein Git-Hook.

mods.name: kontext-anzeige
mods.description: Hinweise, wann /compact, /clear oder Weitermachen sinnvoll ist: Kontextfüllung, Prompt-Cache, Auto-Compact und Limits. Schreibt die Werte für die Statuszeile, die Warnungen zeigt offene-punkte über der Eingabe; /kontext zeigt Details, /kontext test probiert Einblendung, Statuszeile und Systemmeldun…

mods.name: offene-punkte
mods.description: Erkennt nach jeder Antwort offene Punkte – Entscheidungen und Aufgaben mit Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung, blockierende zuerst – und stellt sie über der Eingabe, immer auch mit eigener Antwort. Die Liste geht je Projekt in die nächste Sitzung mit (offen.md, offen.json für claude-web), Entscheidungen…

mods.name: push-wache
mods.description: Prüft vor jedem git push, den Claude in ein öffentliches Repo macht, die neuen Commits auf eigene Muster (Namen, Pfade), fremde Autor-Mails und Geheimnisse. Bei einem Fund fragt sie mit den Fundstellen nach: abbrechen oder trotzdem pushen.

mods.name: anki
mods.description: Review your AnkiWeb decks above the Claude Code prompt while Claude works. Syncs straight with AnkiWeb through Anki's own Rust core; no Anki desktop or AnkiConnect needed.

mods.name: ajan-panosu
mods.description: Claude'u ve alt ajanlarını animasyonlu piksel maskotlarla canlı gösteren yan panel

mods.name: pretty-markdown
mods.description: Draws code fences as bordered, labelled, highlighted blocks, inline code as tinted chips, diffs in colour, callouts and the Next: line as accented boxes.

mods.name: prompt-cards
mods.description: Draws each prompt you send as a blue bordered card, and /prompts lists them in a pane that jumps to any one.

mods.name: working-band
mods.description: While a turn runs, shows what Claude is doing above the prompt: current action, tool count, elapsed time.

mods.name: plusplus
mods.description: Cheaper Claude Code sessions: read and edit by stable line IDs, a model router that sends each task and agent to the cheapest model trusted with it, and a per-project spec and decision tracker

mods.name: clean-view
mods.description: Hides tool calls, diffs and command output and shows one plain-English checklist above the prompt.

mods.name: copy-blocks
mods.description: A one-click Copy button under every code block in Claude's replies, plus /copyblock, so you get clean text without the box.

mods.name: daily-challenge
mods.description: One small Claude Code exercise a day, with your streak and a year of 365 challenges that never repeat.

mods.name: git-ship
mods.description: Repo status row above the prompt and a /ship pane whose buttons fill ready-to-run git and gh commands — you press Enter.

mods.name: mod-doctor
mods.description: Checks that every enabled mod's hooks module actually loaded, and shows why one didn't. Quiet unless something is broken; /mod-doctor opens the report.

mods.name: prompt-upgrade
mods.description: Turns a rough prompt into a great one in a pane: up to three quick questions, a rewrite, and a side-by-side review before anything is sent.

mods.name: relay
mods.description: Context and prompt-cache meter above the prompt, one-click handoffs to a fresh session, and cache warming with a cold-cache guard.

mods.name: roberts-toolbox
mods.description: Robert's Toolbox: one button that opens your mods and the commands that change Claude Code.

mods.name: work-report
mods.description: A pane that counts the tasks Claude finished for you and estimates the hours and dollars they saved.

mods.name: pins
mods.description: Pin highlighted conversation text above the prompt; × clears a pin

mods.name: decision-log
mods.description: Claude logs its judgement calls as it works; approve or reject each one with a comment from a side pane

mods.name: image-preview
mods.description: Inline image previews in the terminal (Ghostty, kitty): under every image Claude reads, above the prompt for pasted images, and on demand with /img

mods.name: pr-watch
mods.description: Watches gate, reviews and post-merge pipelines of Azure DevOps and GitHub pull requests

mods.name: hebrew-rtl
mods.description: Shows Hebrew in the prompt (live mirror above the box) and in sent messages right-to-left and right-aligned, keeping code and English left-to-right

mods.name: agent-watch
mods.description: Flags risky Bash commands and writes to sensitive paths in a live sidebar pane, with a status-line tally.

mods.name: throttle
mods.description: A motorcycle-themed activity gauge: the status line revs up with how many tool calls happen this turn.

mods.name: close-worktree
mods.description: After a PR is opened from a git worktree, tells Claude if the worktree can be closed (clean and pushed) or what is still not saved.

mods.name: commit-ticket
mods.description: Blocks commits without [TICKET] when the branch has a ticket, and commits that only fix linting or formatting; suggests the correct message.

mods.name: guard-actions
mods.description: Saves GitHub Actions minutes: blocks gh run watch/rerun and gh pr checks --watch, and warns when a second PR is opened in the session.

mods.name: live-resources
mods.description: Warns (status line and toast) only when RAM or disk is low: free RAM, free disk and running test runners. When there is no problem, it draws nothing.

mods.name: said
mods.description: /said opens a pane listing every message you sent this session; press one to scroll the transcript to it

mods.name: context-band
mods.description: How full the context window is, as a one-line bar above the prompt, so you know when to /compact or /clear.

mods.name: usage-torch
mods.description: Your Claude usage limit, as a one-line torch bar above the prompt that fades as you use it.

mods.name: rich-input
mods.description: Warp-style Rich Input for Claude Code: the prompt box as a multi-line editor you switch on and off (Enter for a new line, Ctrl+Enter to send), an editor pane for mouse-capable terminals, and @ completion that browses folder by folder

mods.name: where-am-i
mods.description: Pins the checked-out branch and the repo/worktree folder to the status line under the prompt.

mods.name: sea
mods.description: 入力欄の上に、真上から見た浅瀬の波をドット絵で動かす Claude Code のモッド。朝・夕焼け・夜が巡り、波の音 (Windows / macOS / Linux) と、ときどき Claude くんが遊びに来る。(非公式)

mods.name: auto-model
mods.description: Evaluates each prompt and runs the turn on the best-fit model (haiku, sonnet or opus).

mods.name: docker-wsl
mods.description: Muestra arriba del prompt cuántos y cuáles contenedores Docker están corriendo en WSL

mods.name: rendimiento
mods.description: Barra con el CPU, la RAM, la memoria de WSL y el espacio libre en C: de tu computadora

mods.name: keepcachewarm
mods.description: Zeigt über dem Eingabefeld, wie lange der Prompt-Cache noch warm ist, mit Kontext, Limits und Kosten, und hält ihn auf Wunsch in Pausen warm.

mods.name: meta-status
mods.description: Claude Code 입력창 위에 repo·브랜치·미푸시(↑)·수정 파일(✎)·에이전트·열린 일 버튼을 보이고, 세션이 끝내지 못한 일을 장부로 남긴다

mods.name: model-badge
mods.description: Compact badge with the current model and effort in the footer's right corner

mods.name: knowledge-store
mods.description: Query and build knowledge stores made with knowledge-store-builder. knowledge-store: ask a store questions (architecture, duplication, journeys, business intent), with every claim traced to evidence. knowledge-store-build: run the pipeline, including the summary, topic-brief and deep-dive authoring…

mods.name: project-activity
mods.description: 任何專案通用：專案活動 pane（專案狀態、熱門檔案、最近活動）與 Git 狀態 pane，加上測試結果 status line 與回合摘要 band

mods.name: session-stats
mods.description: 工作階段狀態 pane：用量與預報（context、rate limit、compact 預估，可手動重新整理）、任務與執行紀錄（回放）、上下文與改動範圍；context 達 80% 時在回合之間先壓縮，壓縮摘要存到專案 .claude/session-notes/

mods.name: mobile-mode
mods.description: Phone-driven sessions end each turn with tappable AskUserQuestion options and a push notification, injected per-turn and scoped to the session you toggle it in.

mods.name: implement-plan-tracker
mods.description: Live pane with every step of the current plan, the current step marked, and a done/total count

mods.name: orchestrate-mod
mods.description: Ledger pane and per-request cost log for the orchestrate skill

mods.name: voicemesh-controls
mods.description: VoiceMesh controls and Claude Code session bridge

mods.name: voicemesh-said
mods.description: Shows VoiceMesh conversation captions as chat bubbles without starting a Claude turn

mods.name: cc-sidecar
mods.description: See what codex, claude and gemini do when Claude Code delegates to them from Bash

mods.name: session-memo
mods.description: Per-session TODO and memo kept as Markdown, with a band above the prompt and a /memo pane

mods.name: jp-display
mods.description: スピナーや操作ヒントなど Claude Code の英語表示を日本語にする

mods.name: work-status
mods.description: 使用スキル・サブエージェント・モデル・経過時間をパネルでひと目で表示

mods.name: recording-mode

mods.name: baton-notify
mods.description: Claude からバトンが渡ったとき（完了・質問・許可待ち）に、どのセッションかが分かる Mac の通知を出す

mods.name: status
mods.description: ツールバー（入力欄の上）の Menu から、TODO・通知・使用率表示の設定を開く

mods.name: next-steps

mods.name: think-meter
mods.description: Brings the terminal's turn timer to the desktop app: how long each answer took, split into wait, thinking, writing and tools, with tok/s, a live thinking timer and /think-stats

mods.name: curtain
